<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_cdltd_vendor_o_0.VendorRiskUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>VendorRiskUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var VendorRiskUtils = Class.create();
VendorRiskUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

	calculateRiskScore: function (vendorSysId) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord('x_cdltd_vendor_o_0_vendor_request');
		if (gr.get(vendorSysId)) {
			var totalScore = 0;

			if (gr.country.restricted) {
				totalScore += 40;
			}

			if (gr.annual_contract_value > 5000000) {
				totalScore += 20;
			}

			if (gr.category === '4') {
				totalScore += 10;
			}

			var documentGr = new GlideRecord('x_cdltd_vendor_o_0_vendor_document');
			documentGr.addQuery('vendor_request', vendorSysId);
			documentGr.addQuery('received', false);
			documentGr.query();
			
			var penalty = 0;
			while (documentGr.next() && penalty < 30) {
				penalty += 10;
			}
			totalScore += penalty;

			var riskLevel = "High";
			if (totalScore < 30) {
				riskLevel = "Low";
			} else if (totalScore < 60) {
				riskLevel = "Medium";
			}

			return {
				riskScore: totalScore,
				riskLevel: riskLevel
			}
		}

	},

    type: 'VendorRiskUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-06 19:31:14</sys_created_on><sys_id>de945741187b03107f445b56b32389f7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>VendorRiskUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Vendor Onboarding Hub" source="x_cdltd_vendor_o_0">6c78b149183703107f445b56b32389fd</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Vendor Onboarding Hub">6c78b149183703107f445b56b32389fd</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_de945741187b03107f445b56b32389f7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-06 19:31:53</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
